title: A Book Born From the Plague
sentences: One of Europe's most famous books is about ten people hiding from the Black Death.
It's called The Decameron, by Giovanni Boccaccio.
Seven women and three men flee plague-stricken Florence for a villa in the hills.
To pass the time, each of them tells a story every day.
Ten people, ten days, one hundred stories.
Our full Black Death documentary is out today on YouTube.
